purpose: Places in a ring, such as stations on a loop line, seats round a table or children in a circle, taken in the order the arrows go, with the first place coming again after the last. Write each place's number over its ##, right-aligned, mark the place the question starts from with a capital label and ▼ over it, as S here. The place the question asks for is one of those drawn, so it stays unmarked. Add or remove places along the sides without changing the spacing: up to 8 places fit along the top and the bottom and 3 down each side, 22 in all.
